fusions.name: Silk Spit
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 10 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to enemies within 4.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Tether Line
fusions.desc: A thrown line that deals 8 damage, up to 1.8 times its damage at maximum range, and has a 40% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds. It uses up to 3 charges, and kills return one.

fusions.name: Waiting Web
fusions.desc: Conjures a web trap onto the nearest enemy. It waits 30 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 20 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Thread Familiar
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar of poison that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage. It also applies poison, dealing 3 damage per tick for 4 ticks.
